To celebrate its 12th anniversary, high-tech cleaning company Roborock is offering a series of promotions from today until September 6, with discounts on various robot vacuums and other products to mark this special occasion.

The anniversary deals cover a range of products and bundles, with discounts ranging from 25% to over 50%, saving up to $1,600……

Saros 20

The Saros 20 shown above is Roborock's flagship smart robot vacuum, offering unprecedented real-world intelligence, designed for larger and more complex North American homes. Key features include the StarSight Autonomous System 2.0, AdaptiLift Chassis 3.0, Carpet Smart System and Smart Plan 3.0.

StarSight is the most advanced autonomous navigation system on the market, combining dual-emitter solid-state LiDAR with 3D time-of-flight technology to generate highly detailed 3D maps of the home, accurately identifying and avoiding over 300 types of obstacles, from tangled wires to pets with ease.

AdaptiLift Chassis is an advanced chassis system that detects thresholds and steps, then uses motorized legs to automatically lift the Saros 20 over them, ensuring uninterrupted whole-home cleaning. Similarly, the Carpet Smart System automatically adjusts the body height to maintain optimal suction, enabling deep cleaning even on carpets with up to 3cm long fibers.

Smart Plan 2.0 is an AI-powered intelligent cleaning system that analyzes each home's unique layout, flooring types and the habits of every occupant, automatically optimizing cleaning schedules.

Qrevo 2 Pro

The all-new Qrevo 2 Pro makes its debut in the US, positioning itself as the ultimate robot vacuum for pet households. Designed for stubborn stains and pet hair, it features a dual anti-tangle system and 20,000 Pa suction, achieving 100% hair removal with zero tangles. This robot vacuum easily handles pet dander and hair, cat litter, cereal crumbs and muddy paw prints.

Perhaps the trickiest challenge is having pets and long-pile carpets at the same time. The Qrevo Pro 2 tackles this effortlessly with its automatic mop detachment feature, leaving the mop pads at the charging dock to keep carpets completely dry.

F25 Steam

The F25 Steam is the ultimate handheld wet and dry cleaner, combining 25,000 Pa suction with VaporFlow steam cleaning at 356°F.

Key features include up to 80 minutes of battery life, enough to clean the entire home; a 180-degree lay-flat design that reaches deep under furniture; blue light illumination that reveals hidden dust; and a fully automatic steam self-cleaning with hot air drying function after cleaning is complete.

F25 XT

If you need powerful wet and dry cleaning without steam, the F25 XT offers 20,000 Pa suction and SlideTech 2.0 wheels for a smoother, easier cleaning experience.

The F25 XT delivers true edge-to-edge wet and dry cleaning, completing the job perfectly in one go. The JawScrapers roller brush features shark-tooth-shaped anti-tangle bristles that effectively capture hair, while the continuous pressurized scraping design ensures no water streaks are left on the floor. Like the F25 Steam, it also features a 180-degree lay-flat design, with up to 60 minutes of battery life in eco mode—enough to continuously clean up to 4,400 square feet before needing to recharge.

More Deals

The Qrevo S Pro and two of the most popular bundles are also heavily discounted:

  • Qrevo S Pro: Originally $699.99, now $429.99, saving $270 (62% off)
  • Saros 20 + F25GT Bundle: Originally $1,899.99, now $1,269.98, saving $630 (33% off)
  • Qrevo S Pro + F25GT Bundle: Originally $999.98, now $549.98, saving $450 (45% off)

All promotional prices end on September 6, so act fast.
